title: Fema / RBI | State Money Lending Laws Inapplicable to NBFCs Under RBI Act Chapter III-B: SC
description: Fema / RBISC holds Kerala and Gujarat money lending laws inapplicable to RBI-registered NBFCs as RBI Act Chapter III-B provides complete regulatory control.The post State Money Lending Laws Inapplicable to NBFCs Under RBI Act Chapter III-B: SC appeared first on TaxGuru.
